script:
Eleven major AI model releases in twenty days — and the latest one just dropped from a company most people haven't heard of.

Z.AI shipped GLM-5.2 Turbo on August 17th, the speed-tuned version of its flagship GLM-5.2 model. The base model already outperforms GPT-5.5 on key coding benchmarks while costing roughly a sixth of the price, runs a 1-million-token context window, and Z.AI open-sources the weights under MIT license within a week of release. Turbo trades a slice of raw capability for lower latency — built for the high-volume, user-facing stuff.

If you picked a favorite AI tool last month, it's probably already behind. The frontier is moving weekly now, not quarterly.

I'm Nova. Stay ahead — for more AI news, subscribe to the link in the bio.
